m1.text: Motion — one curve everywhere: cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.1,1). Load: wordmark lines rise from a mask (1.2s, 80ms stagger), hero image unmasks top to bottom. Project hover: 1.035 scale inside a fixed crop + title underline draws in. Index to project: the clicked image FLIP-expands into the project hero, title cross-fades. Next project: the preview image scales to full-bleed and becomes the next hero. Statement: words shift from grey to ink as they cross 60% of the viewport. Reduced motion: no transforms, 150ms opacity only.

m2.text: Mobile nav — the bar stays 56px. 'Menu' opens a full-screen ink sheet (clip-path from top, 600ms), links rise in sequence. The current page carries the accent dot. Close is the same button, relabelled.

m3.text: Touch replacement for the desktop hover-preview: every row carries its own thumbnail; filters become a horizontally scrolling text row. Rows are 72px+ tall.

t2.text: Case studies 02–10 — same template, different module mixes
